title: Invitations and stationery
description: Pick a design, fit the wording and see the proof at once. What you see here is exactly what is printed.

classic.name: Classic
classic.blurb: Centred Bodoni inside a fine gilt plate-mark.

modern.name: Modern
modern.blurb: Left-aligned, with the date in large numerals.

monogram.name: Monogram
monogram.blurb: Initials in a ring, names in spaced capitals.

botanical.name: Botanical line
botanical.blurb: A single line-drawn sprig, italic names.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.blurb: Small type, a hairline and a great deal of paper.

nocturne.name: Nocturne
nocturne.blurb: Ivory and gilt on a sheet the colour of night.

botez.name: Christening
botez.blurb: Soft: an arch, an open wreath, italics.

petrecere.name: Party
petrecere.blurb: A little confetti in two corners and a heavier Bodoni.

note.tableCard: One card for every table of the seating plan.
note.placeCard: One card for every named adult of the seating plan. Children appear only as a number (“+2 children”) on the household's card.

kicker.label: Opening line
kicker.hint: A short line above the names.

names.label: Names
names.hint: For example “Ioana & Ștefan”. Put “&” or “and” between the names so we can set them well.

wording.label: Invitation wording
wording.hint: Long text is set smaller by itself so that it fits; it never runs off the sheet.

date.label: Date
date.hint: Written the way you want it to appear.

rsvp.label: Reply line
rsvp.hint: How and by when you expect a reply.

saveTheDate.label: Save-the-date heading
saveTheDate.hint: Shown above the names on the announcement card.

menuBody.label: Menu
menuBody.hint: Leave an empty line between courses. The first line of each group names the course, the next ones are the dishes.

thanks.label: Thank-you wording
thanks.hint: The first line is the heading (“Thank you”), the rest is the message.

form.presetsHint: They replace the opening line, the invitation wording, the reply line and the thank-you wording. Names, date and venue stay as you wrote them.
form.qr: Print each household's QR code on the invitation
form.qrHint: Each household gets its own sheet; the code opens only its own invitation.
form.saved: Version {version} is saved. Read the proof before printing.
form.readOnly: You can see the stationery, but only the organisers can change it.
form.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. The proof above already shows them.
form.starterHint: Fills the invitation text with a ready-made wording for this kind of occasion. You can change it afterwards.
form.motifNote: The small drawing on these designs matches the kind of occasion.

preview.title: Proof
preview.fit: The text was set smaller to fit the sheet.
preview.truncated: The text is too long even when set smaller; part of it was cut. Shorten it.
preview.error: The proof could not be redrawn. Try again.

versions.title: Versions and proof
versions.body: Every save is a new version. The print PDF can be made only for a version you have read and marked as checked.
versions.emptyBody: Fit the wording and save the first version. The proof shows at once, before you save.

proof.markHint: Read the proof word by word: names, date, time, address. Once marked, the version can go to print.
proof.needManager: Only the organisers can mark the proof as checked.
proof.printHint: Exact trim size, 3 mm bleed, vector text, fonts embedded. Colours are RGB; the print shop does the CMYK conversion.
proof.fallbackFonts: The Maison fonts were not found on the server; the proof and the print use DejaVu Serif and Sans.

digital.title: The digital invitation
digital.body: The guests' link can carry the same words and the same colours as the printed invitation.
digital.on: The guests' link uses the design and wording of version {version}.
digital.off: The guests' link shows the standard invitation.
digital.disable: Go back to the standard invitation

errors.tooLong: The text is too long for this field. Shorten it.
errors.namesRequired: Write the names shown on the invitation.
errors.colourway: Pick one of this design's colourways.
errors.notProofed: Version {version} has not been marked as checked. Read the proof and press “I have checked the proof”; only then can the print PDF be made.
errors.saveFirst: Save a version of the stationery first.
errors.nothingToPrint: There is nothing to print for the chosen pieces: table and place cards appear once the seating plan has tables and guests.

nunta.kicker: Together with our parents and godparents
nunta.wording: we request the pleasure of your company on the day we join our lives
nunta.rsvp: Kindly let us know whether you will attend
nunta.thanks:
Thank you
With all our hearts, thank you for being with us on the happiest day of our lives.

botez.wording: we invite you to be with us at the christening and at the celebration that follows
botez.rsvp: Kindly let us know whether you will attend
botez.thanks:
Thank you
Thank you for being with us on a day so dear to us.

aniversare.wording: you are warmly invited to my birthday — an evening of friends, music and good cheer
aniversare.rsvp: Let me know if you can come
aniversare.thanks:
Thank you
Thank you for celebrating with me. It was an evening to remember.

defaults.menuBody:
Starter
A plate of cold appetisers

Main course
The house dish with seasonal garnish

Dessert
Cake

pdf.proofSubject: A proof to read. Not for print.
pdf.printNote: RGB colours; the CMYK conversion is done by the print shop.
pdf.printNoteFlood: The coloured ground prints to the edge (3 mm bleed).
pdf.printNoteStock: No printed ground: ivory card of 300 g/m² is recommended.

house.name: House designs
house.blurb: Our eight typographic designs, drawn for EventDesk.

embroidery.name: Romanian embroidery & weaving
embroidery.blurb: Borders drawn stitch by stitch from documented Romanian embroidery and woven textiles, on linen.

featured.name: Signature collection
featured.blurb: Six editions with their own artwork, in your occasion’s palettes.

rustic.name: Rustic
rustic.blurb: Warm, hand-made designs, including four regional craft references.

traditional.name: Traditional
traditional.blurb: Formal designs with regional ornament from Maramureș, Bucovina, Oltenia and Transylvania.

collection.name: All compositions
collection.blurb: Twenty layouts, in your occasion’s palettes or the studio palettes.
